# Copilot Instructions

All project context and agent operating instructions for this repository are in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

Read `AGENTS.md` before starting any work in this repository.

For patent/paper diagrams that must be copied into cell maps, follow the
interactive source-faithful stamping workflow in
`.github/skills/diagram-stamping/SKILL.md`. The top-down bitmap is the user
review gate: show it before implementation, simulation, commit, or publication
unless the user has already explicitly authorized those steps.
